verdicts.reason: Both shrink the wind-turbine icon, which is the original's focal hero, to a tiny glyph. They also crush the green, red and blue triangles into a cramped strip along the top edge. The text block then fills the bottom with stray diagonal lines around it, so the icon-over-title hierarchy and the airy composition are lost. B centres the title the way the original does, while A's left-aligned text sits off-axis under a centred icon, so B is slightly less wrong.
